message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSVs and image files without validating schema, dtypes, value ranges, or image integrity; it only drops NaN rows and filters by label count.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths with no checksums, signatures, or authentication mechanisms for any remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only drops NaN labels and filters multi-label samples for ambiguity; there is no comparison of label distributions, validation against an expected set, or noise-detection tooling to catch flipped labels.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training samples before they are passed to the data loader.

No detected model integrity verification: The code builds the model from scratch via config.init_obj and optionally resumes from a checkpoint path provided via CLI, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of any loaded weights.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense is present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, cleverhans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (accuracy, balanced_accuracy, sensitivity_per_class) are computed, there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other tamper-protection mechanisms; the evaluator uses the same data_loader passed in from training.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path in evaluate_model() directly passes batched data to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are collected and passed to metric functions without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on the raw output values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision / facial expression classification model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
